title: PMSV India Nutrition Calculation Database
scope: Deterministic nutrition-calculation database. Nutrient composition is accepted only from ICMR-NIN/IFCT. FSSAI is used separately for legal nutrition-labelling rules, RDA/reference values and prescribed calculation factors. Unmapped ingredients remain unmatched; no third-party estimation is permitted.

ifct2017.authority: ICMR-National Institute of Nutrition, Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
ifct2017.title: Indian Food Composition Tables 2017
ifct2017.use: Primary Indian government food-composition source for foods with an exact applicable IFCT entry.
ifct2017.note: IFCT values are per 100 g edible portion. PMSV stores national mean values only when the exact IFCT food identity and nutrient table row are verified.

fssai_labelling.authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
fssai_labelling.title: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Compendium Version VIII (09.09.2025)
fssai_labelling.use: Mandatory nutrient declarations, adult RDA reference values and energy conversion factors.
